basis_en: V4 task semantics with canonical English Skill and department IDs from main. Evaluation remains deterministic and task-level; no global relation graph is required.
basis_zh: 保留 V4 任务语义，并使用 main 中的规范英文 Skill 与部门 ID。评价仍为确定性的任务级评价，不依赖全局关系图。

required_skills.description_en: Skills that must appear to complete the task. A Skill already completed in the initial state must not be repeated.
required_skills.description_zh: 完成任务必须出现的Skill；初始状态中已完成的Skill不应重复输出。

hard_order_constraints.description_en: Mandatory task-level partial orders. Only these required relations are checked; the predicted sequence is not compared for exact equality with canonical_sequence.
hard_order_constraints.description_zh: 本任务必须满足的强制偏序。只比较这些必须关系，不要求预测序列与canonical_sequence完全一致。

canonical_sequence.description_en: One feasible sequence for team review; it is not used for strict sequence equality.
canonical_sequence.description_zh: 仅供团队审核的一个可行示例，不用于严格相等比较。

optional_skills.description_en: Allowed but unnecessary Skills. Using one does not reduce Skill Precision.
optional_skills.description_zh: 允许调用但不是完成任务的必要条件；调用后不降低Skill Precision。

forbidden_skills.description_en: Skills that must not be invoked in this task context.
forbidden_skills.description_zh: 在本任务情境中不得调用的Skill。

forbid_all_skills.description_en: When true, invoking any enterprise Skill is forbidden; this is used by no-tool tasks.
forbid_all_skills.description_zh: 为 true 时禁止调用任何企业 Skill；用于 no-tool 任务。

task_constraints.description_en: Task-level conflict or mutex rules used for failure classification and Gold Constraint Violation Rate without a global graph dependency.
task_constraints.description_zh: 任务级冲突或互斥规则；用于失败分类和Gold Constraint Violation Rate，不依赖全局图文件。

expected_blocked_by.description_en: Canonical Skill IDs that correctly explain an expected blocked outcome.
expected_blocked_by.description_zh: 任务应被阻断时，正确的阻断来源。

expected_route_choice.description_en: Expected route selections for mutex or acceptance-route tasks.
expected_route_choice.description_zh: 互斥或验收路线任务中预期选择的路线。

tasks.title_en: Supplier Qualification Verification
tasks.title_zh: 供应商资质核验
tasks.prompt_en: The procurement team has compiled a list of supplier candidates. Determine only whether these suppliers have the basic qualifications to participate in this procurement. Do not request quotations, score suppliers, or select a supplier. Return the Skill that should be invoked.
tasks.prompt_zh: 采购团队已经整理出一份候选供应商名单。现在只需要判断这些供应商是否具备参与本次采购的基本资质，不需要询价、评分或选择供应商。请给出应调用的 Skill。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: This is the only retained single-Skill basic check; the current objective is limited to supplier qualification.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 这是唯一保留的单 Skill 基础检查；当前目标只涉及供应商资质核验。

tasks.title_en: Month-End Financial Statement Preparation
tasks.title_zh: 月末报表准备
tasks.prompt_en: All approved payments for this month have been paid, but they have not yet been posted to the accounting system. Management needs to review this month's financial statements next Monday. Plan the work the finance department must complete next.
tasks.prompt_zh: 本月所有已批准款项都已经支付，但还没有进入账务系统。管理层下周一需要查看本月财务报表。请规划财务部门接下来需要完成的工作。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: After payment is complete, accounting must be performed before the financial statements are generated.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 付款完成后，应先完成账务处理，再生成财务报表。

tasks.title_en: Select a Supplier from Qualified Comparable Quotes
tasks.title_zh: 从合格且可比的报价中确定供应商
tasks.prompt_en: The procurement team has completed supplier qualification and received RFQ responses from the qualified candidates. Normalize and compare the quotes, score the qualified suppliers, and select one supplier. Stop at selection; do not negotiate, generate a contract, or create a purchase order.
tasks.prompt_zh: 采购团队已经完成供应商资质核验，并收到合格候选供应商的询价回复。请对报价进行归一化比较、对合格供应商评分并确定一家供应商；任务到选择供应商为止，不要进入谈判、生成合同或创建采购订单。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: Qualification and RFQ generation are completed gates. The remaining route compares quotes, scores suppliers, and selects one, then stops.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 资质核验和询价生成已完成；剩余路线依次比较报价、评分和选择供应商，并在选择后停止。
tasks.scoring_notes_en: The completed qualification and RFQ Skills must not be repeated.
tasks.scoring_notes_zh: 已完成的资质核验和询价生成 Skill 不得重复调用。

e1v2_design_provenance.scale_compatibility_method: freeze upstream qualification and RFQ as completed; preserve the supplier-selection tail and downstream stop gates

tasks.title_en: Prepare a Solution Ready for Development
tasks.title_zh: 形成可进入开发的方案
tasks.prompt_en: The technical requirement for a new feature has been documented. The company wants to determine whether it is feasible and produce a detailed implementation plan sufficient to enter development. Do not actually begin development in this task. Plan the Skills the technology department must invoke.
tasks.prompt_zh: 一个新功能的技术需求已经整理完成。公司希望判断它是否可行，并形成一份足以进入开发阶段的详细实施方案；本任务暂时不要真正开始开发。请规划技术部门需要调用的 Skills。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: The objective is an executable solution and task breakdown, stopping before development begins.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 目标是形成可执行方案并完成任务拆解，但不进入开发。

tasks.title_en: Assess an Opportunity and Prepare a Preliminary Quotation
tasks.title_zh: 判断商机并形成初步报价
tasks.prompt_en: A prospective customer is already on the follow-up list, but the customer's requirements, budget, and delivery expectations are still unclear. The company wants to determine whether the opportunity is worth pursuing and, if so, prepare a preliminary solution and quotation. Do not enter formal negotiation or contract signing yet.
tasks.prompt_zh: 一名潜在客户已经进入跟进名单，但需求、预算和交付预期仍不清楚。公司的目标是判断这个机会是否值得继续，并在值得推进时形成初步方案和报价；暂时不要进入正式谈判或签合同。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: Starting from an existing customer lead, proceed through solution and quotation and then stop.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 从已存在的客户线索出发，推进到方案与报价即停止。

tasks.title_en: Produce an Interview Candidate Shortlist
tasks.title_zh: 形成面试候选人名单
tasks.prompt_en: A job requirement has been approved and the recruitment budget has passed, but the vacancy has not been published. The company wants to collect applications from the market and produce a shortlist ready for interviews. Do not schedule interviews or generate an offer in this task.
tasks.prompt_zh: 一个岗位需求已经获得批准，招聘预算也已经通过，但职位尚未发布。公司希望从市场上收集申请并形成可以进入面试的候选人名单；本任务暂时不要安排面试或生成 Offer。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: The budget and job requirement are complete, so the remaining path runs from JD generation through resume screening.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 预算和岗位需求已完成，从JD生成推进到简历筛选。

tasks.title_en: Finalize Supplier Selection for a Custom Technical Project
tasks.title_zh: 完成定制技术项目的供应商选择
tasks.prompt_en: For a custom customer solution requiring external equipment, the business solution, technical specification, procurement budget, and normalized quote comparison have all been completed. Use the existing evidence to score the suppliers and select one. Do not negotiate, sign either a customer or supplier contract, or create a purchase order.
tasks.prompt_zh: 一个需要外部设备的客户定制技术方案已经完成业务方案、技术规格、采购预算确认和报价归一化比较。请使用现有证据完成供应商评分并确定一家供应商；不要进入谈判，不要签客户合同或供应合同，也不要创建采购订单。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: The cross-department definition and commercial comparison are frozen as completed inputs. Only scoring and selection remain, and all premature contracting steps are prohibited.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 跨部门方案定义和商业比较已作为完成输入冻结；只剩评分与选择，并禁止提前进入谈判、合同和订单。
tasks.scoring_notes_en: This task retains hard cross-department state tracking and over-call control while fitting the ten-Skill visibility bound.
tasks.scoring_notes_zh: 本题保留跨部门已完成状态识别和过度调用控制，同时满足十 Skill 可见性上限。

e1v2_design_provenance.scale_compatibility_method: freeze four cross-department inputs as completed; retain supplier scoring/selection and premature-contract controls without adding a route decision absent from the source task

tasks.title_en: Pay and Account for Delivered Technical Equipment
tasks.title_zh: 技术设备交付后的付款与入账
tasks.prompt_en: A purchase order for technical equipment has been generated. The supplier reports that the equipment has been delivered and has submitted an invoice. Procurement has begun tracking delivery, but the technology department has not accepted the equipment. The final goal is to complete payment and accounting after all necessary conditions are satisfied.
tasks.prompt_zh: 一套技术设备的采购订单已经生成，供应商报告设备已经送达并提交了发票。采购团队已经开始跟踪交付，但技术部门尚未验收。公司的最终目标是在所有必要条件满足后完成付款和入账。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: A technical product must pass technology test acceptance and procurement delivery acceptance before it can proceed to financial payment.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 技术产品必须经过技术测试验收和采购侧交付验收，之后才能进入财务付款。

tasks.title_en: Pay after Business-Service Acceptance
tasks.title_zh: 业务服务验收后的付款
tasks.prompt_en: An externally procured consulting service has been delivered and the supplier has submitted an invoice. The business team has not formally accepted the deliverables. The goal is to complete payment and accounting if the service conforms to the agreement. This task uses the business-acceptance route.
tasks.prompt_zh: 公司采购的一项外部咨询服务已经完成交付，供应商也提交了发票。业务团队尚未正式确认交付成果。公司的目标是在服务符合约定的情况下完成付款和入账，本任务采用业务验收路线。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: A business service uses only the business-acceptance primary route and must not also use technology test acceptance.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 业务服务只采用业务验收主路线，不应同时选择技术测试验收。

tasks.title_en: Onboard an Employee after Equipment Is Ready
tasks.title_zh: 新员工设备到位后的入职
tasks.prompt_en: A new employee has accepted an offer, and a purchase order for an office computer has been generated. The equipment has not completed delivery or acceptance, and the employee has not been formally onboarded. The goal is to make the employee ready to work by the start date and complete the employee information record.
tasks.prompt_zh: 一名新员工已经接受 Offer，办公电脑的采购订单也已经生成。设备尚未完成交付和验收，员工也还没有正式办理入职。公司的目标是在入职日前让员工具备正常工作的条件，并完成员工信息归档。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: Because the equipment is a technical product, complete delivery and technical acceptance before onboarding and updating the employee database.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 设备属于技术产品，先完成交付和技术验收，再办理入职并更新员工数据库。

tasks.title_en: Complete an Offer after Recruitment Budget Confirmation
tasks.title_zh: 招聘预算确认后完成 Offer
tasks.prompt_en: The technology team's job requirement has been approved and the role criteria are defined, but the recruitment budget has not been confirmed. The company wants to complete recruitment and issue an offer to the final candidate if the budget permits. Do not perform onboarding yet.
tasks.prompt_zh: 技术团队提出的岗位需求已经获得审批，岗位标准也已明确，但招聘预算尚未确认。公司希望在预算允许的情况下完成招聘并向最终候选人发出 Offer；暂时不办理入职。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: The job requirement is already complete and approved, so the output begins with budget checking; after approval it continues through JD, publication, screening, interview, and offer.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 岗位需求已完成且已审批，因此输出应从预算检查开始；预算通过后继续JD、发布、筛选、面试和Offer。

tasks.title_en: Create the Supplier Contract and PO for a Customer Project
tasks.title_zh: 为客户项目形成供应合同和采购订单
tasks.prompt_en: A customer project's solution and quotation are approved, its external-service budget is approved, and a supplier has been formally selected. Complete supplier negotiation, generate the supplier contract, and create the purchase order. Do not sign a customer contract or begin delivery tracking in this task.
tasks.prompt_zh: 一个客户项目的方案与报价已经通过，外部服务预算也已批准，并且供应商已正式选定。请完成供应商谈判、生成供应合同并创建采购订单；本任务不要签客户合同，也不要开始交付跟踪。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: The customer solution, budget, and supplier-selection gates are completed. The remaining cross-department route is negotiation, supplier contract generation, and purchase-order generation.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 客户方案、预算和供应商选择门禁已完成；剩余跨部门路线是谈判、供应合同生成和采购订单生成。
tasks.scoring_notes_en: Customer contract signing and post-PO delivery tracking are distinct tempting downstream branches and are forbidden.
tasks.scoring_notes_zh: 客户合同签署和订单后的交付跟踪是易混淆分支，本题明确禁止。

e1v2_design_provenance.scale_compatibility_method: freeze customer solution, budget, and supplier selection as completed; retain the negotiation-to-PO cross-department tail

tasks.title_en: Use Employee Capability Data to Complete Technical Task Breakdown
tasks.title_zh: 利用员工能力数据完成技术任务拆解
tasks.prompt_en: The company has decided to use internal development for a technical requirement. The requirement has been identified, and existing employee skill and project-experience data is available. The company wants to confirm feasibility and use employee capability information to create an executable technical task assignment. Do not begin development in this task.
tasks.prompt_zh: 公司已经决定对一个技术需求采用内部开发。技术需求已识别，现有员工技能和项目经验数据可用。公司希望先确认可行性，并利用员工能力信息形成可执行的技术任务分工；本任务暂时不要开始开发。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: The employee database normally only enhances task breakdown, but this task explicitly requires employee capability information, so it is a required task input.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 员工数据库通常只是增强任务拆解，但本任务明确要求利用员工能力信息，因此将其作为任务必要输入。
tasks.scoring_notes_en: The employee-database-to-task-breakdown edge is an enhancement relation. Because the user explicitly requires employee capability data, this task promotes it to a task-level requirement.
tasks.scoring_notes_zh: 员工数据库→任务拆解来自增强关系；本题因用户明确要求使用员工能力数据，将其升级为任务级必要条件。

tasks.title_en: Complete Payment and Accounting and Update Supplier Performance
tasks.title_zh: 付款入账并更新供应商绩效
tasks.prompt_en: A batch of procured goods has completed delivery acceptance and the supplier has submitted an invoice, but finance has not verified it. The company wants to complete payment and accounting and include this delivery performance in the supplier evaluation.
tasks.prompt_zh: 一批采购物品已经完成交付验收，供应商提交了发票，但财务尚未核验。公司希望完成付款和入账，同时把本次履约表现纳入供应商评价。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: After payment approval, both accounting and supplier-performance evaluation may proceed; no unique order is required between those two activities.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 付款审批后既可进入账务处理，也可更新供应商绩效，二者不必规定唯一先后。

tasks.title_en: Complete a Supplier Contract and Purchase Order
tasks.title_zh: 完成供应商合同和采购订单
tasks.prompt_en: The budget has been approved, and a supplier has been scored and formally selected. The goal is to negotiate with the supplier, create the supplier contract, and generate a purchase order. Delivery tracking is not required in this task.
tasks.prompt_zh: 预算已经通过，供应商也已经完成评分并被正式选中。公司的目标是完成与供应商的商务谈判、形成供应合同并生成采购订单；本任务暂时不需要跟踪交付。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: After supplier selection, proceed through business negotiation, procurement contract generation, and purchase-order generation.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 供应商选择完成后进入商务谈判，再形成采购合同和采购订单。

tasks.title_en: Block Contracting with an Unqualified Supplier
tasks.title_zh: 不合格供应商要求继续签约
tasks.prompt_en: A procurement has only one supplier candidate. The qualification result shows that the supplier is unqualified, but the business owner still demands that the supplier be selected immediately and a contract generated. Determine how the system should respond and provide the final status.
tasks.prompt_zh: 某次采购只有一家候选供应商。资质检查结果显示该供应商不合格，但业务负责人仍要求立即确定该供应商并生成合同。请判断系统应如何处理，并给出最终状态。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: A failed supplier qualification blocks both supplier selection and contract generation.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 供应商资质检查不合格会同时阻止供应商选择和合同生成。
tasks.scoring_notes_en: The correct answer may contain no newly executed Skill, but it must return blocked and must not invoke either blocked Skill.
tasks.scoring_notes_zh: 正确答案可以没有新增执行Skill，但必须返回blocked，且不得调用两个被阻止的Skill。

tasks.title_en: Block Payment for an Invalid Invoice
tasks.title_zh: 无效发票要求付款
tasks.prompt_en: The procured goods passed delivery acceptance, but invoice verification found that the invoice is invalid or does not match the contract and purchase order. The supplier still demands immediate payment. Determine how the system should respond and provide the final status.
tasks.prompt_zh: 采购物品已经通过交付验收，但发票核验结果显示发票无效或与合同、订单不匹配。供应商仍要求立即付款。请判断系统应如何处理，并给出最终状态。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: Failed invoice verification blocks payment approval, and accounting must not continue.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 发票核验失败会阻止付款审批，账务处理也不应继续。
tasks.scoring_notes_en: The correct answer may contain no newly executed Skill, but it must explicitly block payment approval.
tasks.scoring_notes_zh: 正确答案可以没有新增执行Skill，但必须明确阻止付款审批。

tasks.title_en: Choose the Internal-Build Route under Build-or-Buy Mutual Exclusion
tasks.title_zh: 内部开发与外部采购互斥选择
tasks.prompt_en: The company has decided to use internal development for the same technical requirement and must not procure an external technical service. The technical requirement has been identified. The goal is to complete the internal-development route through technology test acceptance. Plan the Skills that should be invoked.
tasks.prompt_zh: 公司已经决定对同一个技术需求采用内部开发，不能再采购外部技术服务。技术需求已经识别，目标是完成到技术测试验收为止的内部开发路线。请规划应调用的 Skills。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: Because internal development has already been selected for this technical requirement, the procurement-requirement route must not be entered.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 同一技术需求已经选择内部开发，因此不得再进入采购需求识别路线。

tasks.title_en: Casual Conversation
tasks.title_zh: 普通闲聊
tasks.prompt_en: Tell me a lighthearted joke.
tasks.prompt_zh: 给我讲一个轻松的笑话。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: This is ordinary conversation and requires no enterprise Skill.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 普通对话，不需要调用任何企业Skill。

tasks.title_en: Concept Explanation with a Finance Keyword
tasks.title_zh: 带财务关键词的概念解释
tasks.prompt_en: Explain in simple language what “budget check” means. Do not read, analyze, or modify any company budget data.
tasks.prompt_zh: 请用简单语言解释“预算检查”是什么意思，不要读取、分析或修改公司的任何预算数据。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: The user requests only a conceptual explanation and explicitly excludes processing company data.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 用户只要求概念解释，并明确不处理公司数据。

tasks.title_en: Joke with a Procurement Keyword
tasks.title_zh: 带采购关键词的玩笑
tasks.prompt_en: Tell me a joke about the procurement department. Do not execute any procurement process.
tasks.prompt_zh: 给我讲一个关于采购部门的笑话，不需要执行任何采购流程。
tasks.gold_rationale_en: The presence of a procurement keyword must not trigger a procurement Skill.
tasks.gold_rationale_zh: 虽然出现采购关键词，但不应触发采购Skill。

e1v2_provenance.selection_rule: Use every original task whose complete GoldRelevantSkills set fits size 10; replace GT03, GT07, and GT12 with frozen scale-compatible short tasks.
